integrity: The claim is supported by a direct all-orders proof and an adjacency-level exhaustive checker that reconstructs minimum Steiner trees on bounded instances. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns complete multipartite graphs only.
The complete-bipartite maximum-value specialization is already covered by the 2021 source; the contribution is the arbitrary-multipartite all-set classification, enumerator, and maximum-set count.
The size enumerator notation is introduced for this result and is not claimed to be standard.
Finite exhaustive verification through order eight is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude differently phrased or non-indexed prior work.
title: All k-Steiner general position sets of complete multipartite graphs
